## Complexity calculation

The same supplied band function is used in both phases: evidence-size contribution (over 16/48 KiB), document contribution (more than one), actor contribution (over 4/16), state-object contribution (over 0/1), total-system contribution (over 4/16), contradictions (any gives 2), ambiguities (over 2/8), and safety boundaries (over 2/8). A score of at least 7 is high; at least 3 is moderate. All dimensions, including non-scoring dimensions, appear separately for H0/H1.

Heat and river each have five operational roles, seventeen required but passive source relationships, and four implementation components. Their H0 score is actors 1 + state object 1 + systems 2 + safety 2 = 6. Healthcare and recovery each have seventeen accountable operational roles, five passive sources, and four components. Their H0 score is actors 2 + state object 1 + systems 1 + safety 2 = 6.

All H0 evidence is below 16 KiB and has one document. The actual H1 correction provides a second evidence document, adding 1 and bringing all cases to 7. No ambiguity, contradiction, invented default, enlarged evidence, source custodian, lifecycle status, or record field is used to inflate a band. One governed record remains one object in every phase.

## Semantic and capacity decisions exposed for adjudication

- Required upstream systems stay material and scored even when they take no first-path action or report no problem/no observations. They are source relationships with distinct operators, scope, authority, and identity; they are not product actor steps.
- Ownership-only component relations do not invent execution events. Separately stated actions such as retaining exports, checking prerequisites, recording status, holding a rehearsal, preserving method differences, and retaining conflicting observations do appear as system duties.
- A prohibited action does not become a performed event. Public alerts, dispatch, private fetching, unauthorized upstream mutation, patient-data ingestion, production connections, credential possession, and excluded operational products retain their distinct boundary meanings.
- Positive conditional behaviors are retained as both action duties and guards when the source independently states the action. Missing-lift blocking, expired-committee blocking, missing-training blocking, source-change invalidation, overnight hold, and recipient-purpose hold are not erased into prose-only safety constraints. Pure permission/compatibility predicates do not invent an additional execution mechanism.
- Two verbs in one path sentence stay separate: associate/record, check/record, verify/close, attach/record, download/record, and verify/mark. A single verb with a compound explicit target is one duty carrying every named target, not an invented set of repeated performer actions.
- Healthcare H1 uses a possessive noun for the sponsor representative site-insurance confirmation. It is conservatively a separate declared action with bounded_interpretation custody, not merged into the original sponsor authorization. All specified coverage reference/date/site/trial/start fields remain explicit.
- Healthcare expressly permits checking input presence and currency. That is conservatively a distinct bounded optional system capability, alongside completeness/authority checking. It does not assert the optional check performs every run. Counting this capability places healthcare exactly at 32 rather than hiding capacity uncertainty.
- River reviewer clearance is retained as a separate conditional supporting human duty from recording a disposition. Its sole-performer permission does not require approval of every packet. Generic manual source attachment also remains separate rather than collapsed to lower the total.
- Recovery retains the generic accountable-specialist conflict-resolution action and conditional source-custodian manual attachment action. Those generic supporting actors are aliases or upstream custodians, not additional independently accountable product roles for complexity.
- H1 retains all original handoffs, sources, mappings, limitations, and evidence on the same record. Correction preservation duties and added proof are explicit; no old duty is silently removed. Cleanup never deletes review evidence.
- State fields and source relationships do not automatically create proof duties. Final independently stated evidence requirements and explicit preservation requirements are sectioned as proof; the complete state-field and source inventories remain separate.
